subject: Q2 spike adjudication and settlement plan
messages:
From: Kyle Dawson <kyle.dawson@novaedge.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Q2 usage spike – reconciliation request

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We ran into a pretty sharp spike in API usage between 2027-06-10 and 2027-06-20 that pushed our bill ~3.2x the expected run-rate. Our internal ops team attached a brief CSV with session-level tokens but we wanted to loop you in to understand next steps for reconciling retroactive usage.

High level:
- Expected monthly tokens: ~3M
- Observed (June window): ~9.6M
- Delta: ~6.6M tokens

We recognize this is our usage but need a clear settlement path (one-time invoice vs credit vs amortized charge). Can you confirm your recommended approach & provide an itemized overage calculation? Also let us know what documentation Redwood needs to validate behaviour on your side (logs, request ids).

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround here.

Kyle
Kyle Dawson
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaEdge
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Dawson <kyle.dawson@novaedge.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q2 usage spike – reconciliation request

Thanks for the flag, Kyle — and sorry to hear this caused a bill surprise. I’m looping in Ben (billing) and Tessa (account), and we’ll get you a clear, actionable plan this week.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben & team will verify the raw token export you sent against our server-side usage logs. Please attach the CSV you mentioned (session IDs + timestamps) if you haven’t already.
2) We’ll produce an itemized overage calculation (token bands, effective per-M token rate, and any applicable discounts).
3) Options we’ll surface: one-time invoice, one-time credit, or a three-month amortized invoice. We'll include the math so you can pick.

Operational note: if you prefer an amortized approach, please confirm PO number or accounting instructions — that helps expedite invoicing on our end. For validation we expect: your session CSV + any traces for a few representative request IDs (we’ll reconcile our logs).

I will pause any collection/late-fee actions while we reconcile. Ben — can you pick this up and aim to have a proposed settlement draft by 2027-07-02 EOD? Tessa — please schedule a quick 30-min sync with NovaEdge for Thursday if they’re available.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Dawson <kyle.dawson@novaedge.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed settlement numbers (draft) — DEAL-9021

Kyle / team — thanks for the patience. We completed an initial reconciliation between NovaEdge's CSV and our server logs. Summary below (attached: proposed_settlement_48000.pdf with line-by-line math).

Summary (June 10–20 window):
- Baseline covered by committed capacity: 3,000,000 tokens
- Actual billed tokens (redwood logs): 9,600,000 tokens
- Uncovered delta: 6,600,000 tokens
- Standard overage rate (post-discount for DEAL-9021): $7.27 per 1M tokens
- Proposed one-time charge = 6.6 * $7.27k ≈ $48,000 (rounded)

Settlement options (pick one):
A) One-time invoice for $48,000 (net 30)
B) One-time credit applied to future months equivalent to $48,000 (applied across next 3 billing cycles)
C) Amortized invoice: $16,000 billed at invoice creation, then two monthly invoices of $16,000 each (Net 30 each).

Notes:
- We have marked this as a one-off anomaly in NovaEdge’s account to avoid automated escalation.
- We recommend NovaEdge also enable a short-term hard cap or quota for the most aggressive endpoints to prevent recurrence; Tessa can coordinate a recommended config change.
- Attachment has the exact token bucket math + raw IDs we matched; we redacted PII.

If NovaEdge confirms option B or C, please share the PO number (if required) and any invoicing instructions. If you confirm A, we’ll push an invoice to finance and provide payment instructions.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(attachment: proposed_settlement_48000.pdf)
From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@novaedge.io>

Cc: Kyle Dawson <kyle.dawson@novaedge.io>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed settlement numbers (draft) — DEAL-9021

Thanks Ben — and thanks for doing the reconciliation so quickly. NovaEdge would prefer option C (amortize over 3 months). Please treat this as confirmation to proceed with that approach.

PO details below (attached PO_12345.pdf) — please reference PO# 12345 on the first invoice. We also request: no late fees and clear invoice line that says "Q2 retroactive overage — June 10–20 adjudication" for our AP team to route correctly.

We’ll also schedule the 30-min sync to review recommended quota settings.

Best,
Priya Nair
Finance Manager, NovaEdge
(attachment: PO_12345.pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q2 spike adjudication and settlement plan

Folks — thanks for the quick alignment. Final action items and timeline: 

1) Finance (Ben / Stephanie) to issue first invoice of $16,000 referencing PO#12345 and DEAL-9021; invoice to be dated 2027-07-15 (Net 30). Follow-up invoices of $16,000 will be generated on 2027-08-15 and 2027-09-15.
2) No late fees to be assessed for this reconciliation window; we’ve noted the account as an exception.
3) Tessa to run a short configuration review with NovaEdge this week to set a soft cap and alerting on the busiest endpoints.
4) Ben to upload the final reconciled CSV and the signed settlement PDF to the HubSpot deal folder (link below) and mark the deal note: "Retro adjudication settled — amortized plan accepted."

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-9021
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-settlement_docs

Kyle / Priya — if that timeline works I’ll confirm when the first invoice hits your AP mailbox. Appreciate the partnership — if anything else comes up please reply-all and we’ll triage.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
